title: LibWeb: Properly simplify sum nodes containing negated sum nodes
task_prompt: Fix the failing test Tests/LibWeb/Text/input/wpt-import/css/css-values/calc-nesting-002.html. When simplifying calc() expressions, a sum node that contains a negated sum node (e.g., calc(1px - (2px + 3px))) is not correctly simplified — the negation is not distributed over the inner sum's children, producing wrong computed values. The expected output is in Tests/LibWeb/Text/expected/wpt-import/css/css-values/calc-nesting-002.txt.
